source_language=en

非 CJK 建议 24~42 字符，硬上限 56 字符。
不要 Markdown，不要解释。

<finalized_transcript>
By the time the ferry reached the island, the morning fog had begun to lift. A shopkeeper was arranging fresh bread in the window opposite the landing stage. We bought two rolls and asked for directions to the footpath along the eastern shore. She drew a quick map on a paper bag, adding a star beside a sheltered beach. That small gesture changed our plans, and we spent the afternoon by the water.
</finalized_transcript>

lines: By the time the ferry reached the island, the morning fog had begun to lift.
A shopkeeper was arranging fresh bread in the window opposite the landing stage.
We bought two rolls and asked for directions to the footpath along the eastern shore.
She drew a quick map on a paper bag, adding a star beside a sheltered beach.
That small gesture changed our plans, and we spent the afternoon by the water.
